violation_type.title: Critical Injury - Contact EMS After Ensuring Supervision of Group (26 TAC §744.2577(1))
violation_type.short_title: Critical Injury - Contact EMS After Ensuring Supervision of Group
violation_type.typical_finding: During an investigation, it was found that the operation called the parent but not EMS when a child received a head injury requiring stitches after falling from a basketball hoop.
